The budget already fits. Power is 1.8 V × (1 + 2 + 6) µA = 16.2 µW. Predicted GBW is about 1.4 MHz, and Rz places the zero to cancel p2.

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1":  (13.0, 8.0, 20.0),     # diff pair gm/Id
    "L1":     (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),       # diff pair L
    "kt":     (2.0, 1.0, 3.0),       # tail = kt * iref
    "k7":     (6.0, 4.0, 7.5),       # 2nd-stage current = k7 * iref
    "gmidp":  (13.0, 9.0, 15.0),     # PMOS mirror load + M6 gm/Id (equal -> consistent DC)
    "Lp":     (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),       # PMOS L (M3/M4/M6)
    "Ln":     (2.0, 1.0, 3.0),       # NMOS current-source L (bias/tail/M7)
    "gbw_t":  (1.4e6, 1.1e6, 2.5e6), # target GBW -> sets Cc
    "rz_k":   (0.8, 0.4, 1.3),       # Rz = rz_k*(CL+Cc)/(gm6*Cc)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 1e-6)
    itail = p["kt"] * iref
    i7 = p["k7"] * iref
    id1 = itail / 2
    gmidn = 10.0

    mb = lut.size("n", gmidn, p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.6)           # ibias diode
    m5 = lut.size("n", gmidn, p["Ln"], itail, vds=0.35)         # tail
    m7 = lut.size("n", gmidn, p["Ln"], i7, vds=0.9)             # 2nd-stage sink
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], id1, vds=0.5)       # diff pair
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], id1, vds=0.9)       # mirror diode
    m4 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], id1, vds=0.9)       # mirror out
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], i7, vds=0.9)        # CS 2nd stage

    gm1 = m1.gm
    cc = gm1 / (2 * PI * p["gbw_t"])
    cc = min(max(cc, 0.2e-12), 10e-12)
    rz = p["rz_k"] * (cl + cc) / (m6.gm * cc)
    rz = max(rz, 1.2 / m6.gm)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M1", "n1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "nd", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "nd", "nd", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "n1", "nd", "vdd", "vdd", m4)
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    n.R("RZ", "n1", "nz", rz)
    n.C("CC", "nz", "vout", cc)

    a1 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m4.gds)
    a2 = m6.gm / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    gain_db = db(a1 * a2)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cc)
    c1 = m6.cgg + m4.cdd + m1.cdd
    p2 = m6.gm * cc / (2 * PI * (c1 * (cl + cc) + cl * cc))
    dz = cc * (rz - 1.0 / m6.gm)
    fz = 1.0 / (2 * PI * dz) if dz > 0 else 1e12
    pm_ = m3.gm / (2 * PI * (m3.cgg + m4.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd))
    p3 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * rz * c1)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fz)) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pm_)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p3))
    power = vdd * (iref + itail + i7)
    slew = min(itail / cc, i7 / (cl + cc))
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power, "slew": slew}
```
